external_actions.statement: One official MCP Registry record was published and verified. One IndexNow batch returned 202 with validation pending. No person-directed messages or library catalogue submissions were sent.

limitations: HTTP 403 or an empty search result does not establish absence from a service.
Metadata availability does not establish local library activation, a holding, human readership or course adoption.
The existing ORCID book record must not be confused with the separate SSRN essay After the Offshore Trust Turn.
